'''Derrick Caracter''' (born May 4, 1988) is a [[Power forward (basketball)|power forward]]/[[center (basketball)|center]] for the [[University of Texas at El Paso]] basketball team and formerly of the [[Louisville Cardinals]]. He withdrew from the 2008 NBA Draft and later that summer left the [[University of Louisville]]. He then enrolled at the [[University of Texas at El Paso]] and, as required by NCAA regulations, sat out the 2008-09 basketball season. He became eligible to play in the second half of the 2009-2010 season.
Caracter grew up in [[Fanwood, New Jersey]]. He played high school basketball at [[St. Patrick High School (New Jersey)|St. Patrick High School]] as a freshman, attended [[Scotch Plains-Fanwood High School]] as a sophomore, to team with fellow SPF native, and subsequent Duke Blue Devil PF Lance Thomas, before returning to St. Patrick's for his junior year. Caracter transferred to boarding school [[Notre Dame Preparatory School (Fitchburg, Massachusetts)|Notre Dame Preparatory School]] during his senior year to focus on academics.
